units.title: MachineFingerprintEngine + per-machine truth catalog
units.scope: src/engines/MachineFingerprintEngine.ts: taper class (BT40/HSK63A/Capto), pull-stud retention force, way type (LM/box), ballscrew lash + wear class, structural FRF (X/Y/Z + spindle nose), thermal coefficient (μm/°C), warmup time, soft-limit envelope, rotary-axis feed-rate ceiling, kinematic topology enum (TT/HH/HT/mill-turn/Swiss). Per-machine in fleet manifest.

units.title: Sidecar fingerprint_sha + drift canary on fingerprint change
units.scope: machine_fingerprint_sha in sidecar; drift canary (MS9) rejects when fingerprint changes; alerts maintenance if change unexpected.

units.title: Envelope soft-limit predicate (PreEmit #11)
units.scope: Per-axis travel + rotary singularity check; gates emit on out-of-envelope. Multus sub-spindle handoff (MS15) uses this.

units.title: Probe vendor adapter (Renishaw/Blum/Heidenhain/Marposs)
units.scope: src/engines/ProbeVendorAdapterEngine.ts; per-vendor M-codes, strobe sequences, calibration cycles. Generic 'probe emit' (PPG-MS13/U-PPGM83) routes through this.

units.title: Per-machine thermal growth model + warmup curve
units.scope: Hurco welded-frame, Okuma cast-iron, Roku-Roku polymer-concrete: distinct thermal coefficients + warmup curves. MS11 closed loop attributes thermal vs material drift correctly.

completion_criteria: MachineFingerprintEngine carries 11 physical-truth fields per machine
